issue_context.title: VisualShader: TransformUniform qualifier can be set to "Instance" which is not supported
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0-dev (20210811)

### System information

Windows 10, Vulkan, RTX2080

### Issue description

Using the test build  [Godot_v4.0-dev.20210811_win64](https://downloads.tuxfamily.org/godotengine/testing/4.0/4.0-dev.20210811/)

It is currently possible to set the qualifier of TransformUniform nodes in the VisualShader editor to "Instance" which throws an error.

**"Uniforms with 'instance' qualifiers can't be of matrix type."**

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new visual shader
2. Add a TransformUniform node and set its qualifier to "instance"
3. Connect via TransformVectorMult node to Albedo

See minimal reproduction project

### Minimal reproduction project

![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8405059/129187955-19008045-5950-4900-9acb-088b19ec446a.png)

review_comments: This will produce `This uniform type does not support '' qualifier.` I suppose? Or this condition would never be hit?
